title: GHOLITE
tagline: Lite site to interact with Gho token. Quickly borrow or repay your Gho tokens.
description: Simple app that demonstrates using various Aave provided libraries to build a sleek interface to interact with the Gho token. Quickly see your Gho balance and borrow amount, and interact with the Gho token on the Sepolia testnet. This can be later extended to support other chains.
how_its_made: It's built using Astro with React as a front-end interactivity library. It also uses ConnectKit for wallet connection, then it uses viem and wagmi to build and send transactions on the blockchain. It uses Aave provided libraries as well as aave-address-book for simpler interaction with smart contracts related to Gho.
